authority_rule: These profiles are the permitted design, topology and formatting grammar. Production economics may correct demonstrated source defects, but may not drift from this visual language.

precedence.immutable_authorities: sheet order, horizontal geometry, section presentation, hierarchy, formatting, saved views and print geometry
precedence.production_contract: corrected economics, user-input meaning, dynamic company-specific rows and explicit source-defect repairs

measured_authority_artifacts.inert_default_font_record: The OOXML font table starts with Carlito 11, but occupied body-cell styles use Calibri 8. Exact authority replay preserves the record; the production body-font contract is Calibri 8 and must be tested from physical cell styles, not workbook.default_font.
measured_authority_artifacts.acquisition_debt_row: The authorities label the acquisition funding row as Debt % of EV. Production corrects this demonstrated source defect inside the same panel geometry: the input is an absolute supplied acquisition-debt amount.
measured_authority_artifacts.print_setup_silence: The authorities carry page margins but no complete pageSetup/print-scaling record. They cannot prove fit-to-width by silence; production print geometry needs a separate explicit contract and mutation gate.

scope_separation.exact_replay_fixture: Literal authority formulas, labels, broker demo identities, values, caches, row addresses and legacy acquisition labels are fixture-only and may be used solely for exact authority replay.
scope_separation.production_design_contract: Production consumes semantic controls, row roles, resolved style roles, horizontal geometry and named expansion zones. It must not inherit authority demo identities, cached economics or legacy percentage-debt semantics.

production_controls.broker_choice: semantic source selector; authority demo broker names are not normative
production_controls.circularity: numeric 0/1 input with data validation and On/Off conditional display
production_controls.debt_maturity_roll: numeric 0/1 input with data validation and On/Off conditional display
production_controls.adjustment: numeric 0/1 input with data validation and On/Off conditional display

acquisition.target_ebitda: derived as enterprise value divided by entry multiple
acquisition.acquisition_debt_amount: absolute supplied debt amount; never a percentage of enterprise value
acquisition.prohibited: consideration/equity residual cash funding and EV-minus-debt RCF sweep

production_controls.conditional_formatting: On/Off rules may change displayed control text/style but may not change body provenance font colours

production_print_contract.authority_basis: Authority presence and silence are measured separately; silence does not prove production pagination.
production_print_contract.print_area: declared per compiled used range and verified independently after recalculation

shared_horizontal_grammar.company_specific_rows: may expand or contract within the grammar; exact authority replay remains exact

exact_authority_replay: immutable authority hash and byte count
dynamic_company_model: movable rows resolved through semantic IDs and the compiled row map, never literal addresses
within-zone row movement preserves validation; out-of-zone movement and stale literal dependencies fail
no residual demo identity, values or caches
measured render conformance to the selected profile
